categories.title: Uniquem Basics
categories.description: Welcome to Uniquem and the first safety rules everyone follows on site.

categories.title: Loading and Unloading
categories.description: The docks, the trucks, and how we load and unload.

slides.title: Welcome to Uniquem
slides.caption: Welcome to Uniquem. Safety is everyone's job here. Follow your manager's direction, and if you're ever unsure about a task, stop and ask.

slides.title: No smoking anywhere on Uniquem property
slides.caption: There is no smoking anywhere on Uniquem property, inside or outside, including the doors, loading docks, trailers and parking lot. Our products and their vapours can catch fire. Put it out, and only smoke off the property.

slides.title: Forklifts: make eye contact
slides.caption: When you see a forklift, stop and wait. Make eye contact with the driver before you move. Drivers stop and confirm they have seen you too.

slides.title: Steel-Toe Boots Required
slides.caption: Our warehouse runs forklifts and power jacks every day. Steel-toe boots are required at all times when you are in the warehouse.

quiz.q: You are not sure how to do a task on site. What should you do?
options: Work it out on your own
Stop and ask your manager
Skip the task
quiz.explanation: Always follow your manager's direction. When in doubt, stop and ask.

quiz.q: Where on Uniquem property is smoking allowed?
options: Nowhere on Uniquem property
Outside by the warehouse back door
By the trailers at the loading dock
quiz.explanation: No smoking anywhere on Uniquem property, inside or out. Put it out and only smoke off the property.

quiz.q: A forklift is coming toward you in the warehouse. What do you do?
options: Cross quickly before it arrives
Wave and keep walking
Stop, wait and make eye contact with the driver before you move
quiz.explanation: Stop and make eye contact so the driver knows you are there. Only move once the driver has stopped and seen you.

slides.title: Our Docks and Trucks
slides.caption: We have 3 docks and two kinds of trucks: containers and trailers.

slides.title: Talk to the Driver First
slides.caption: Before anyone goes into a trailer, talk to the driver and make sure the truck is stopped and parked.

slides.title: Check the Trailer Is Stable
slides.caption: Check if the truck is still hooked to the trailer. If the trailer stands alone, make sure its jacks are far enough to the front. If not, place our own jacks under the trailer before going in.

slides.title: Light On, Dock Plate Set
slides.caption: Trailers have no lights inside. Before you go in, swing the dock light into the trailer and turn it on so you can see everything. Then set the dock plate so it sits flat and secure on the trailer floor.

slides.title: Entering with Equipment
slides.caption: Before you drive a forklift into a trailer, double check that your seatbelt is buckled. If you're using a power jack, only one power jack goes into the trailer at a time.

slides.title: Can't See? Drive Backwards
slides.caption: If you're carrying two stacked totes or pallets and can't see in front of you, never drive forward. Always drive backwards and look in the direction you're travelling.

quiz.q: How many docks do we have?
What must you do before entering a trailer?
options: Start loading right away
Talk to the driver and make sure the truck is stopped and parked
Honk the horn
quiz.explanation: Talk to the driver and make sure the truck is stopped and parked before anyone goes into the trailer.

quiz.q: The trailer is not hooked to a truck and its jacks aren't far enough forward. What do you do?
options: Go in carefully
Place our own jacks under the trailer before going in
Ask the driver to hold it
quiz.explanation: If the trailer stands alone and its jacks aren't far enough forward, place our own jacks under the trailer before going in.

quiz.q: What should you do before going into a dark trailer?
options: Turn on the dock light and point it into the trailer
Use your phone flashlight
Go in slowly without a light
Ask the driver to turn on the trailer lights
quiz.explanation: Trailers have no lights inside. Swing the dock light into the trailer and turn it on before you go in.

quiz.q: What must a forklift operator do before driving into a trailer?
options: Double check the seatbelt is buckled
Honk the horn twice
Raise the forks all the way up
Drive in fast to save time
quiz.explanation: Double check the seatbelt is buckled before driving a forklift into a trailer.

quiz.q: You're carrying two stacked totes and can't see in front of you. What do you do?
options: Drive backwards, looking where you're going
Drive forward slowly
Lean out to the side and drive forward
Ask someone to walk in front of you
quiz.explanation: If you can't see in front of you, drive backwards and look in the direction you're travelling.
